name: Lili Boniche
description: '''Lili Boniche''', born '''Eliaou Élie Boniche''' ({{langx|ar|ليلي بونيش}}; 29 April 1922 – 6 March 2008) was a [[French people|French]]-[[Algerians|Algerian]] singer and [[songwriter]]. From the 1930s and up to the end of his career in the late 1990s, he was mainly known as composer and interpreter of [[Chanson franco-orientale|Franco-Arab chansons]] in [[Morocco]], [[French Algeria]] and [[Metropolitan France|mainland France]].
